# The One Group

> AI consulting and implementation agency for small and mid-sized businesses, based in South Florida. We build practical AI automation systems that respond to leads in under 5 minutes, monitor competitors 24/7, and produce compliant content for regulated industries. No hype, just results.

## Services

- [AI Visibility Audit](https://theonegroup.info/ai-audit.html): Comprehensive audit of your AI presence and opportunities. 30-page report, competitor comparison, action roadmap. $2,500.
- [AI Implementation](https://theonegroup.info/ai-optimization.html): Full AI system setup and integration for your business. $2,500-$10,000.
- [Lead Response Automation](https://theonegroup.info/lead-response.html): Every inbound lead answered in under 5 minutes - enriched, researched, personalized. $297/month + setup.
- [Competitor Intelligence](https://theonegroup.info/competitor-intelligence.html): 24/7 competitor monitoring with alerts within 1 hour of changes. $297/month.
- [Multi-Platform Content](https://theonegroup.info/social-media.html): Daily content across Twitter, LinkedIn, Reddit, newsletter, and YouTube Shorts. $997/month.
- [Compliance Content](https://theonegroup.info/compliance-content.html): HIPAA, SOC2, FINRA-compliant AI content packs for regulated industries. $497 one-time.
